fact: Regulation 74/2023 of 18/09/2023, in the Official Gazette of 25/09/2023, sets four categories of payment service provider licence issued by the Central Bank, including e-money issuance.
title: Regulation N° 74/2023 governing payment services providers
publisher: National Bank of Rwanda (Official Gazette n° 38 Bis of 25/09/2023)
